scope: research implementation verification; working tree, no commit

maintenance.label: production-worker-http-concurrent-compaction
maintenance.methodology: Compaction RPC is posted before 40 sequential real loopback HTTP searches, so searches cannot overtake its start at the worker. Counts searches whose replies arrive before the compaction RPC resolves. Verifies retained documents, reclaimed tombstone bytes, and the HTTP no-op compaction route. Includes HTTP/RPC overhead. Snapshot commits and individual large records remain synchronous.

concurrentImport.label: production-worker-http-concurrent-import
concurrentImport.methodology: Real loopback HTTP, one bulk import and sequential streams of 40 health and 40 search requests started concurrently. Each search is followed by a stats request to verify searches observe partially indexed batches. Existing unique reference must remain first. Includes RPC, JSON and HTTP overhead. Does not model many users, large PDFs, or physical disk faults.

limits: Semantic and reranker tests use fixture provider, not measured model quality
Browser checks are bounded smoke checks, not a full screen-reader audit
OCR fixture is one generated image-only page, not complex layout quality evidence
Maintenance HTTP connections are warmed before timing; earlier cold-connection runs missed overlap
